label: MiCA Gap Analysis
description: Comprehensive compliance gap assessment against EU MiCA (Regulation 2023/1114). Covers CASPs (Title V), EMT issuers (Title IV), ART issuers (Title III), and utility token offerors (Title II). Produces RAG-rated gap matrix, prioritised remediation roadmap, and board-ready executive summary.

modelTier.notes: MiCA article citations must be accurate. Opus 4.7 strongly recommended.

claudeKnowledge.description: MiCA Regulation 2023/1114, ESMA/EBA MiCA RTS and ITS, ESMA Q&A, NCA guidance
